## Data Model
No ledger change. Reports land in `<git-common-dir>/hefesto/deps/<tool>.json`, beside the ledger.

## Implementation Approach
`deps-diff`: one function per ecosystem that turns a manifest's text on stdin into `name<TAB>spec`
lines (`npm_deps` jq; `py_deps` awk over requirements lines and the `[project] dependencies` array;
`cargo_deps` awk over the three sections; `go_deps` awk over `require` single and block forms); the arm
runs each changed manifest's old and new text through its function and joins the two sorted lists
(`join -a1 -a2 -e…`, or awk) into added/changed/removed. `deps-audit`: per ecosystem, `command -v` the
auditor, run it with its JSON flag into the report file, count with the jq expression in FR-002 (`|| echo
unknown`), print the line. The pre-commit block calls the helper by its path next to the hook
(`$(dirname "$0")/speckit-helper.sh`), and prints the JSON with `jq -n`.

## Code Sketches (Mental Alignment)

### Sketch 1: parsers
```bash
npm_deps()   { jq -r '[.dependencies, .devDependencies, .optionalDependencies, .peerDependencies] | map(. // {}) | add | to_entries[] | "\(.key)\t\(.value)"' 2>/dev/null; }
py_deps()    { awk 'BEGIN{a=0} /^\[project\]/{p=1} /^\[/&&!/^\[project\]/{p=0} p&&/dependencies *= *\[/{a=1;next} a&&/\]/{a=0} a{gsub(/[",]/,"");print} !p&&!a&&/^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]/{print}' | sed -E 's/^ *//; s/ *#.*//' | awk 'NF' | sed -E 's/^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)(\[[^]]*\])? *(.*)$/\1\t\3/'; }
cargo_deps() { awk '/^\[(dev-|build-)?dependencies\]/{s=1;next} /^\[/{s=0} s&&/=/{n=$1; sub(/^[^=]*= */,""); print n"\t"$0}'; }
go_deps()    { awk '/^require \(/{b=1;next} b&&/^\)/{b=0} b&&NF>=2{print $1"\t"$2} /^require [^(]/{print $2"\t"$3}'; }
```
(requirements files carry no `[project]` header, so their non-comment lines are the dependencies; a
pyproject's other tables are skipped by the `p` flag.)

### Sketch 2: deps-diff
```bash
deps-diff)
  staged=0; base=""; for a in "${@:2}"; do case "$a" in --staged) staged=1 ;; *) base="$a" ;; esac; done
  if [ "$staged" = 1 ]; then old="HEAD"; files=$(git diff --cached --name-only); else old="${base:-$(git merge-base HEAD main)}" || die …; files=$(git diff --name-only "$old"); fi
  for f in $(grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|requirements[^/]*\.txt|pyproject\.toml|Cargo\.toml|go\.mod)$' <<<"$files"); do
    eco/fn by basename; o=$(git show "$old:$f" 2>/dev/null | $fn | sort); n=$( { [ "$staged" = 1 ] && git show ":$f" || cat "$f"; } 2>/dev/null | $fn | sort)
    awk -F'\t' -v e="$eco" 'NR==FNR{o[$1]=$2;next} {if(!($1 in o)) print "added "e" "$1" "$2; else if(o[$1]!=$2) print "changed "e" "$1" "o[$1]" -> "$2; delete o[$1]} END{for(k in o) print "removed "e" "k" "o[k]}' <(echo "$o") <(echo "$n")
  done | sort
```

### Sketch 3: deps-audit — per tool `run_auditor <tool> <jq-count> <cmd…>`: run into `$dir/<tool>.json`, `rc=$?`, count via jq or `unknown`, print the line, set `any_find`/`ran`.

### Sketch 4: pre-commit advisory
```bash
if grep -qE '(^|/)(package\.json|requirements[^/]*\.txt|pyproject\.toml|Cargo\.toml|go\.mod)$' <<<"$STAGED"; then
  added=$( (cd "$CWD" && bash "$(dirname "$0")/speckit-helper.sh" deps-diff --staged) 2>/dev/null | grep '^added ' || true)
  [ -n "$added" ] && ADVISORY="$(grep -c . <<<"$added") new dependenc… staged ($(awk '{print $2" "$3}' <<<"$added" | paste -sd, -)) — run /hef.scan --deps before the PR"
fi
… at the success exit: [ -n "${ADVISORY:-}" ] && jq -nc --arg c "$ADVISORY" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",additionalContext:$c}}'; exit 0
```
(`STAGED` is computed earlier in the hook; the advisory is emitted only on the success path — a
blocking failure already exits 2 with its own message.)

each; PATH stubs `npm`, `pip-audit`, `cargo` (with `audit` subcommand), `govulncheck`, `osv-scanner` that
print fixture JSON; hook driven with a JSON event on stdin as the existing hook fixtures do.

## Constitution Compliance
- [x] 1 root payload. 2 no new command (`/hef.scan` gains a flag). 3 fixtures + named mutations, stubs
  record argv. 4 bash/jq/awk/git; auditors detected, never installed. 5 `unknown` never reads as 0;
  exit 3 for "nothing could run" is a distinct answer, named in the output.

## Risks & Mitigations
| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|------|--------|------------|
| Auditor JSON formats drift | a wrong count | `unknown` + exit 1 on parse failure, never 0; the report file is kept for a person |
| Lexical TOML/requirements parsing misses an exotic form | a dependency not listed | documented scope (direct deps, common forms); the audit tools still see the real lockfile |
| The advisory slows the commit | pre-commit tier >5 s | `deps-diff --staged` is git show + awk, no network |

## Plan review 2026-10-02 (fresh `code-reviewer`, REVISE_PLAN, 9 changes; parsers measured on fixtures) — applied
1. `py_deps` split by mode: requirements files in line mode (option lines `^-` skipped), `pyproject.toml`
   in table mode reading only `[project] dependencies` — the measured parser emitted `requires`,
   `dev = […]` and `line-length` as dependencies.
2. The join drops empty records (`NF` on both sides): a newly created manifest no longer prints a
   phantom `removed` line; fixture added.
3. `go_deps` skips `// indirect`.
4. **Count rule**: a number only when the exit is in the tool's valid set AND `jq -e '<expr> | numbers'`
   succeeds — else `unknown` (npm ENOLOCK printed `null` at jq rc 0; osv-scanner with no lockfile exits
   128 with empty results; govulncheck is a stream, counted with `jq -s` as distinct advisory ids).
5. Rust needs the `cargo-audit` binary (cargo is on PATH here, `cargo audit` is not); run `cargo-audit
   audit --json`. Python: `-r <file>` per requirements file, `.` for pyproject-only.
6. Base: merge base with `main`/`master`, else `pr_base`, die when nothing resolves.
7. Ecosystem tokens fixed: `npm`, `pypi`, `crates`, `go`.
8. SC-003 asserts on captured stdout with `jq -e`, with a mutation; the stub/fixture cases above.
9. `/hef.scan`'s scope note: `--deps` is the exception to "fast, offline"; the hook comment records the
   first hook→helper subprocess (`$(dirname "$0")`).
